summary.result: The results of this displacement distribution can be applied as a basis for determining the position of reinforcement at the downstream slope and the crest.
summary.background: In this study, an overtopping model experiments and three dimensional seepage characteristics at the deteriorated homogeneous reservoirs were performed to investigate the behavior of failure for embankment and spillway transitional zone due to overtopping.
summary.method: In the peak stage, the pore water pressure was significantly increased in all locations due to the influence of seepage.
